sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of imlunestrant during breastfeeding. The manufacturer recommends not to breastfeed during treatment with imlunestrant and for 1 week after the last dose. If it is used with other agents, breastfeeding should not resume for the longest post-treatment duration recommended for the individual agent(s).
